confirm.title: Add Straton X
confirm.description: Connect to {address} and read its identity and tank group. Leave the passcode at 0 unless you changed it in ATI.

error.cannot_connect: Could not identify the light. Check Bluetooth range and close the ATI app connection, then retry.

abort.no_devices_found: No unconfigured Straton X lights are visible. Check your Bluetooth proxy and try again.

init.title: Polling and Wi-Fi fallback
init.description: Schedules are read at startup or manually. Bluetooth recovery delays are 30–120 seconds. Optional Wi-Fi fallback reads telemetry only. Enter a bare IP/hostname, or enter a private subnet (for example 192.168.1.0/24) to scan once for this light's serial. Scanning can take up to two minutes. Clear both Wi-Fi fields to disable fallback. Live-mode controls still require Bluetooth.

error.wifi_unverified: Could not uniquely verify this light over Wi-Fi. Check its IP/subnet and network access. A scan can miss slow devices; try entering the IP directly.

progress.wifi_scan: Searching the selected subnet for this light's serial. This can take up to two minutes.
